internal_ip.description: The internal IP address of a workload VM.
internal_ip.rationale: The internal IP address identifies the workload VM that is mapped to an external address. Only approved internal IP addresses should be used to avoid exposing unintended workloads.

parent.description: The resource name of the private cloud to create a new external address in. Resource names are schemeless URIs that follow the conventions in https://cloud.google.com/apis/design/resource_names. For example: projects/my-project/locations/us-west1-a/privateClouds/my-cloud
parent.rationale: The parent value determines which private cloud the external address belongs to. Using an approved parent helps ensure that the external address is created only within a trusted and approved private cloud.

name.description: The ID of the external IP Address.
name.rationale: External address names should follow an approved naming standard so that resources can be clearly identified, audited, and managed consistently.

description.rationale: The description is used for documentation and does not directly change the security posture of the external address.
